name: Praising Oneself
overview: Scripture teaches that true praise belongs to God alone, who has done great and mighty works on our behalf, as seen in Deuteronomy 10:21 and Psalms 103:1. Believers are cautioned against boasting or praising themselves, recognizing human frailty and the uncertainty of life (Proverbs 27:1-2; Isaiah 64:6). Instead, we are called to humbly trust in God's power, for with Him nothing is impossible (Luke 1:37), affirming that all glory and honor rightly belong to Him rather than to ourselves.
